Enum OperationType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<OperationType>
org.gradle.tooling.events.OperationType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<OperationType>, Constable
public enum OperationType extends Enum<OperationType>
Enumerates the different types of operations for which progress events can be received.
See Also:
  • LongRunningOperation.addProgressListener(ProgressListener, java.util.Set)

  • Enum Constant Details

    • TEST

      public static final OperationType TEST
      Flag for test operation progress events.

      The following events are currently issued for this operation type.

      • TestStartEvent
      • TestFinishEvent

    • TASK

      public static final OperationType TASK
      Flag for task operation progress events.

      The following events are currently issued for this operation type.

      • TaskStartEvent
      • TaskFinishEvent

    • GENERIC

      public static final OperationType GENERIC
      Flag for operations with no specific type.

      The following events are currently issued for this operation type.

      • StartEvent
      • FinishEvent
      • StatusEvent

    • WORK_ITEM

      public static final OperationType WORK_ITEM
      Flag for work item operation progress events.

      • WorkItemStartEvent

    • TEST_OUTPUT

      public static final OperationType TEST_OUTPUT
      Flag for test output operation progress events.

      Clients must subscribe to TEST events too if they want to receive test output events.

      The following events are currently issued for this operation type.
      • TestOutputEvent
      Since:
      6.0

    • TEST_METADATA

      @Incubating public static final OperationType TEST_METADATA
      Flag for test metadata events.

      Clients must subscribe to TEST events too if they want to receive test metadata events.

      The following events are currently issued for this operation type.
      • TestMetadataEvent
      Since:
      8.13

    • FILE_DOWNLOAD

      public static final OperationType FILE_DOWNLOAD
      Flag for file download progress events. This includes various types of files, for example files downloaded during dependency resolution, Gradle distribution downloads, and Java toolchain downloads.

      The following events are currently issued for this operation type.

      • FileDownloadStartEvent
      • StatusEvent
      • FileDownloadFinishEvent
      Since:
      7.3

    • BUILD_PHASE

      @Incubating public static final OperationType BUILD_PHASE
      Flag for build phase events.

      The following events are currently issued for this operation type.

      • BuildPhaseStartEvent
      • BuildPhaseFinishEvent
      Since:
      7.6

    • PROBLEMS

      @Incubating public static final OperationType PROBLEMS
      Flag for problem events.

      The following events are currently issued for this operation type.

      • ProblemEvent
      • SingleProblemEvent
      • ProblemSummariesEvent
      Since:
      8.4

    • ROOT

      @Incubating public static final OperationType ROOT
      Flag for the topmost progress event.

      Using this operation type is useful for capturing the build failure details from the finish event. The following events are currently issued for this operation type.

      • StartEvent
      • FinishEvent
      Since:
      8.12
